fields.description:
Implement TOTP-based two-factor authentication (2FA) for user accounts. Users should be able to enable 2FA via an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy).

Requirements:
- TOTP generation/verification
- QR code enrollment flow
- Backup codes
- Remember device for 30 days

comments.body: High demand from enterprise customers. Required for SOC 2 certification.
We can use the speakeasy library for TOTP generation.
